claims.claim: B is running around in front of the TV

evidence.quote: Stop running around in front of the TV

claims.adjudication_reason: The imperative 'Stop running around in front of the TV' directly presupposes that B is currently running around in front of the TV.

claims.claim: B is in front of the TV
claims.attribute: B's location relative to the TV

evidence.quote: Stop running around in front of the TV

claims.adjudication_reason: Entailed by the same presupposition as c1; B being 'in front of the TV' is a necessary condition of 'running around in front of the TV.' Not bidirectionally equivalent to c1 (c1 is more specific), so not a duplicate.

claims.claim: B asked for or wants an explanation of something

evidence.quote: I will explain it to you later on

claims.adjudication_reason: A's response 'I will explain it to you later on' presupposes B requested or wanted an explanation. The definite 'it' indicates a specific topic B raised.

claims.claim: B asked A to explain something
claims.attribute: B made a request for explanation about some topic

evidence.quote: All right , I will explain it to you later on

claims.adjudication_reason: A's 'All right, I will explain it to you later on' strongly implies B asked or pressed for an explanation, prompting A's concession. The 'All right' signals agreement to a request.

claims.claim: B was in a position where A told B to leave/scram
claims.attribute: B was being dismissed or told to go away by A
claims.adjudication_reason: A's 'Now scram' is a direct command to B to leave, establishing B was in a position where A wanted B gone. This is a necessary inference from the imperative directed at B.

claims.claim: B complained or expressed inability about watching TV
claims.attribute: B voiced some complaint or excuse about not watching TV

evidence.quote: Then stay away . Nobody's keeping you from doing that

claims.adjudication_reason: A's 'Then stay away. Nobody's keeping you from doing that' in turn 3 responds to something B said that implied B couldn't watch or was complaining about not being able to watch. 'Nobody's keeping you' presupposes B claimed an obstacle existed.
